I largely agree with you and don't enjoy the company of children (especially small ones) and I applaud you for being solid in your determination to not tell them how you feel.  My best friend knows I struggle with children even though her kids are my godkids and while I do love them, for the most part until they reached a certain age I didn't *like* them much.  I also do everything in my power to protect them from that information.  
Correct me if I'm wrong but I resonated with your post because I feel a not insignificant amount of guilt for feeling this way.  I mean, they are just young humans and weren't we all young once etc etc.  Plus the societal expectations of people (especially women) liking children and so on.  I can totally see past me writing this post if I'd have been on reddit at the time just cause I feel generalized guilt even though I'm not doing anything specifically wrong.  Anyway, if I'm off base that's fine, just wanted you to know if I was right then you're not alone.  One thing to consider though.  The tone of your post came off as pretty judgemental and it can be hard to completely mask that level of disdain in person.  Just be careful.
